explanation: Bounds the recursion depth of one complete wanted query. The valid requested depth and source-size restrictions bound the recursion of the exact wanted-record implementation.
theorem_title: Wanted query depth fits the uniform envelope
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $K\le J(n)$, $N\le3M(n)^3$, and $N_B,N_C\le n$. With executable local parameters, the exact wanted-record call-depth bound satisfies $$\operatorname{wantedDepth}\le\operatorname{wantedEnvelope}(n).$$ Here $M$ is the reporting magnitude envelope.

Bounds the recursion depth of one complete wanted query. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
